about: The judge of one place audit. Facts are in the audit; the verdict and every threshold are here and in film-settings.json (place_* sections).

checks.text: not a quick trial
every visible object has a role (2 objects)
everything that is drawn is a mesh (or has a never role)
role prop.crate: missing normal_map, roughness_variation, colour_variation, dirt, wetness, edge_wear.
checks.fix: run explainer-film-place finish (or the verb that makes it: surfaces, age, grow, damage); do not lower the requirement.

checks.text: role prop.crate: wanted but missing grime, weathering.
role ground.earth: missing normal_map, displacement, roughness_variation, colour_variation, dirt, grime, weathering, wetness, cracks_and_chips, rubbish, plants, litter_pieces.
checks.fix: run explainer-film-place finish (or the verb that makes it: surfaces, age, grow, damage); do not lower the requirement.

checks.text: role ground.earth: wanted but missing moss_and_algae.
no litter pieces on the ground (1 ground material(s) or object(s)).
no plants on the ground (1 ground material(s) or object(s)).
every layer amount is there and above its floor (state "dry")
nothing is switched off
0 normal map(s): Non-Color, tangent, wired, pointing the right way
every normal-mapped object has UVs, none mirrored beyond the limit
ground colour: no displacement (role ground.earth needs it)
checks.fix: run explainer-film-place surfaces (it sets the method and grades or subdivides the mesh); roads: explainer-film-place roads.

checks.text: 1 part(s) carried from the ground up; nothing floats; scattered pieces are left out on purpose
1 size(s) fit the real-world facts
50% of the objects are plain sharp-edged boxes (at most 15%).
checks.fix: run explainer-film-place surfaces (it bevels every hard-edged role) and damage; if they have run, these objects have a role the surfaces step does not bevel (ground, water, glass, plants, trees), so chamfer their meshes yourself (bmesh.ops.bevel) or give them a role that is not a plain box.

checks.text: triangles and scattered pieces are within the budgets; 4 objects (at most 1,000)
the scene has light
renderer EEVEE: nothing is lit: no lamp but the sun, no glowing material, no glow object (EEVEE is fine when the lights are off)
not marked for the film ("for_film" is not true in place-settings.json): any frame shape is allowed
View crate: 290 of its 544 rays below the horizon hit nothing (53%): the view sees past the edge of the ground into empty sky.
checks.fix: every view must see a finished horizon: continue the plain ground to the horizon and hide its edge (a low rim bank, faded out beyond about 60 m); put an all-round backdrop of real shapes with the role backdrop (finish turns its shadow off; give it a plain unlit colour); set every view camera's clip end to 1000 m or more; turn the shadow off on far scenery (Object > Visibility > Shadow).

checks.text: no view has more than 50% of the ground it sees shadowed from the sun "Sun" (50 degrees up)
no sign, notice, placard, poster, name board or book in the place

place_audit.world.unit: metres from the nearest view camera, metres across, share of a view's rays that go below the horizon and hit nothing

place_audit.sun.unit: share of the ground points a view sees that are shadowed from the sun; degrees between the sun the wear layers' shade used and the scene's sun lamp
